div.head: Cn 1018 2
div.ab: And uton godes cirican. griðian 7 friðian. 7 gelomlice secan us silfan to þearfe.
And uton Godes cirican griðian and friðian, and gelomlice secan us silfan to þearfe.
And let us maintain the peace and protection of the churches of God, and frequently attend them in our need.
And let us preserve and protect God’s churches, and attend them frequently for our own benefit.
